messages:
Anya: quick sync — ACME accelerated their timeline. they want a private deploy with reserved throughput in early June. need a short ownership map for runtime changes, infra capacity, and security gating so we can give a delivery date.

Mike P: I can take runtime work (kernel tuning + batching/kv-cache changes). will need QPS and prompt length distribution and desired p95 to size correctly.

Carlos: infra note: current enterprise slots show 2 GPUs free-ish Jun 10-16 but we have other trials. if ACME expects sustained 150-200 rps we should plan +1 GPU and a prewarm window.

Dena: product launch criteria: 1) p95 latency <=100ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens); 2) steady throughput >=150 rps for business hours; 3) audit log export to customer SIEM (alpha can omit); 4) canary with 3 pilot customers before GA.

Rachel: security: we need KMS/HSM integration and an architecture review. pen test estimated 2-3 weeks depending on scope. need data-flow diagram for logs & keys.

Mike P: regarding latency vs throughput: we can reduce batching window to 20ms for ACME to hit p95, but cost per-token will go up. i'll prototype latency-first profile and bench by next Tue.

Carlos: suggested allocation: cluster `private-june-1` (2 GPUs) + burst cluster `private-june-burst` (+1 GPU). prewarm policy: prewarm=true, window=30m. will need an infra ticket for the change and a failover runbook back to hosted endpoints.

sec-team: heads-up — file the architecture review in the security queue and tag us. @Rachel to own the review comments.

infra-bot: reminder — cluster `private-june-1` available windows: Jun 10-14, Jun 17-21. run `infra reserve private-june-1` to claim.

Dena: can we shorten security gating by shipping a reduced feature set for pilots? e.g., disable external SIEM streaming initially to reduce scope.

Rachel: yes — we can scope trials without SIEM forwarding: keep internal audit logs and give customers access to stored artifacts. this reduces attack surface and may shrink pen-test time. KMS still required.

Mike P: rollout plan I propose: 1) perf bench + config bake 2) canary on `private-june-1` with feature-flagged SIEM off 3) A/B canary with fallback to hosted (50/50) 4) GA and enable SIEM after security signoff. i'll draft checklist.

Carlos: ops constraints — need infra backlog ticket + automated failover runbook (route to hosted models + traffic cutover steps). I can draft runbook and smoke tests.

Anya: action items: 1) Mike P: bench + checklist by Tue; 2) Carlos: open infra ticket + draft failover runbook by Fri; 3) Rachel: file arch review + confirm pen-test scope by EoW; 4) Dena: update roadmap entry and customer comms draft by Thu. i'll add these to the initiative card and tag owners.

Anya: config snippet i'll attach to the card for clarity:

```yaml
reserved:
  cluster: private-june-1
  gpus: 2
  burst: private-june-burst
  prewarm: true
  prewarm_window: 30m
```

Carlos: ack — i'll claim the reserve after ticket is created.

Dena: ack — comms will say "limited features during trial" and call out when SIEM will be enabled.

Mike P: one more ask — product to supply ~30 representative prompts for QA to validate quality after quantization/kv-cache changes.

Dena: will collect and share by EOD tomorrow.

Anya: thanks all. i'll summarize on the initiative card and schedule a checkpoint next Mon. :thumbsup:
